repo_map_source: unchanged 10-core-repo map from GitHub release family
signal_series: daily count of GitHub is:issue creations by created_at UTC date
score: mean(latest 7 complete UTC-day issue creations) - mean(previous 28 complete UTC-day issue creations)
signal: zero up-cross -> SHORT; zero down-cross -> LONG
oos_read_policy: do not read 2025+ unless discovery passes
